Module com.example.escriturarapida
Package com.example.escriturarapida.events

Interface GameListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameAdapter
public interface GameListener
Custom event interface. Any class that wants to react to what happens in the game (for example, the user interface) implements this interface.
